architecture.mechanism: Temperature and total dissolved solids concentration have a cumulative effect on the biofilm and spore formation of Geobacillus stearothermophilus.
architecture.intervention: Implement a temperature control system to maintain a temperature below 65°C in the district cooling loop, and adjust the total dissolved solids concentration to below 20% (w/v) to prevent biofilm and spore formation on the stainless steel plate heat exchanger.
architecture.expected_effect: The heat transfer coefficient should remain above 2500 W/m2K for 12 months between mechanical cleanings, and the pressure drop between cleanings should be reduced.
architecture.falsification_test: Monitor the heat transfer coefficient and pressure drop over a 12-month period, and perform regular cleaning and inspection of the heat exchanger to verify the effectiveness of the intervention.
